title.ko: as … as · the … the · so / such · too / enough
title.en: as … as · the … the · so / such · too / enough

explain.ko: as + 형용사 + as는 '~만큼 ~한', not as … as는 '~만큼 ~하지 않은'입니다. 'The + 비교급, the + 비교급' 구조는 '~할수록 더 ~하다'는 뜻입니다. too는 '너무 ~해서 안 되는'(too hot to drink), enough는 '충분히'(big enough)로 형용사 뒤에 둡니다. so는 형용사 앞에(so hot), such는 명사구 앞에(such a good film) 씁니다. much, a lot, a bit으로 차이의 정도를 나타냅니다.
explain.en: Use as + adjective + as to say two things are equal, and not as … as to say one is less. The structure 'the + comparative, the + comparative' means that two things change together. Too means 'more than is acceptable' (too hot to drink) and enough follows the adjective (big enough). Use so before an adjective (so hot) and such before a noun phrase (such a good film). Use much, a lot and a bit to show the size of a difference.

head: 구조 / Structure
뜻 / Meaning
예문 / Example
rows: He is as tall as his father.
This isn't as expensive as that.
The more you practise, the better you get.
The coffee is too hot to drink.

notes.ko: so는 형용사 앞, such는 (a +) 형용사 + 명사 앞입니다.
notes.en: So goes before an adjective; such goes before (a +) adjective + noun.

notes.ko: enough는 형용사 뒤: big enough, 명사 앞: enough money.
notes.en: Enough goes after an adjective (big enough) and before a noun (enough money).

notes.ko: much / a lot / a bit + 비교급으로 차이의 크기를 말합니다.
notes.en: Use much / a lot / a bit + comparative to show the size of a difference.
